scientific.claim: For binary length-six single-deletion-correcting codes \(C\subseteq\{0,1\}^6\), the maximum cardinality is \(10\), and exactly nine labeled maximum codes attain it. Under the explicit order-four symmetry group generated by global bit complementation and word reversal, the nine maxima split into six orbits of sizes \(1,1,1,2,2,2\). Exactly one maximum is a Varshamov--Tenengolts syndrome class, namely \(VT_0(6)\); the other eight maxima are not VT classes. All nine maximum codes contain the common four-word core \(\{000000,001100,110011,111111\}\).
scientific.integrity: The result is derived from the deletion-shadow definition and a bundled exact finite verifier; no external certification or independent audit is claimed.
limitations: Finite classification only for binary length six.
The order-four complement/reversal group is explicit but is not asserted to be the full automorphism group.
Residual originality risk: an obscure unindexed historical equality classification may exist.

title: Complete equality census for binary length-six single-deletion codes
